remarks: Experience the best of in-town living in this bright and inviting ranch, tucked among the trees in one of New Canaan's most sought-after neighborhoods. Ideally located just moments from the train station, boutique shops, fine dining, scenic Mead and Irwin Parks, and the town's new state-of-the-art library, this home offers both convenience, charm and access to New Canaan's top-rated schools. Freshly painted throughout, the residence sits on a private 0.21-acre lot and features over 1,300 square feet of living space, including 400 square feet in the finished lower level. With its prime location, comfortable layout, and relaxing outdoor space, this rental is a rare opportunity for those seeking a vibrant New Canaan lifestyle - just move in!
